bizcity_skills.purpose: Machine skill prompt and routing registry. This table is not the canonical Journal authoring store. ORPHANED SCHEMA OWNER (WP-12 N40, 2026-09-27): the owning module core/skills was archived in R3; no installer creates this table on a new site any more. Retiring this table for real (R13f) needs TwinBrain's matcher to get its candidates from the unified tool catalog instead, which is gated on PHASE-0.87 CL-9 (remove the old client-side PHP reply path) -- not started as of 2026-10-01. Do not drop or quarantine this table before CL-9 ships.
